structured_output.summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.setMonth in the same order as the spec. this_time_value performs the RequireInternalSlot check and reads [[DateValue]] before any ToNumber. ToNumber(month) and ToNumber(day) run in spec order, and day presence is tested with args.len() > 1, which matches "present" for an explicitly passed undefined. The NaN early return happens after the conversions and before LocalTime, as in step 6. DateFromTime is used when day is absent (step 8). MakeDay, MakeDate, UTC and TimeClip are composed as in step 9-10, the value is stored with set_time_value (step 11), and the result is returned (step 12). There are no special-cased inputs, no hardcoded values and no swallowed errors. The only other edits are renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target and removing the stub's trailing comment about length and the getDate() NOTE. Neither affects behaviour. The helpers in crate::support::date are not shown, so their internals were not checked; the gate's clean build means they exist.
